title: Learn Common Actions
summary: Learn a small set of useful Kreyòl action verbs and use them in short subject-plus-action sentences.

sketchBlocks.title: manje, bwè, travay, etidye, ale
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Start with a few useful action words:

- **manje** — eat
- **bwè** — drink
- **travay** — work
- **etidye** — study
- **ale** — go

These verbs will appear again in later modules, so learn them as reusable building blocks.

sketchBlocks.title: Mwen manje
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
A simple beginner sentence can be just a subject plus an action:

- **Mwen manje.** — I eat.
- **Ou manje anpil.** — You eat a lot.
- **Li travay.** — He/she works.

The verb does not change its spelling for different people.

sketchBlocks.title: Pronouns + action
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
The pronouns from Module 3 work directly with action words:

- **Mwen etidye.**
- **Ou travay.**
- **Li manje.**
- **Nou ale.**
- **Yo bwè.**

This makes it easy to build many new sentences from a small vocabulary.
